lines.zh: 四条腿走过雪地，不留脚印。
lines.en: Four legs cross the snow without leaving prints.
My ribs slide beneath the hide.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，像腿多了两条。
lines.en: I walk crooked, as if I had two legs too many.
My throat sac swells, then flattens.
I skirt my own kind; it watches me.

lines.zh: 爪子在冰上打滑，我站稳。
lines.en: My claws slip on ice; I find my footing.
This hide does not fit me well.

lines.zh: 我停在树后，先看清再说。
lines.en: I pause behind a tree to look first.
The skin at my mouth splits and closes.
My breathing sounds wrong when I walk.

lines.zh: 我跟着脚印，一步都不差。
lines.en: I follow the tracks, not missing a step.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在地上，像忘了收。
lines.en: My tail drags as if I forgot to lift it.
I head downhill with my body tilted.

lines.zh: 雪被我的爪刨开一道沟。
lines.en: My claws gouge a trench in the snow.
The closer I get, the tighter this hide feels.

lines.zh: 我停下舔了舔裂开的嘴角。
lines.en: I stop and lick the split at my mouth.
I sit with my tongue hanging out.
Something itches under this coat.

lines.zh: 我歪头，听雪落下的声音。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to snow fall.
My throat is preparing something.
I lift a hind leg to scratch my ear.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味带向村子。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent toward the village.
I stay motionless, like a dead dog.
I stare at the smoke in the distance.
Something under my hide rolls over.
I belch, and the smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我把自己盘起来，很安静。
lines.en: I curl up and go very quiet.
I am counting how many people are left.

lines.zh: 我舔自己的爪子，很仔细。
lines.en: I lick my own paw, carefully.
I bury my nose in the snow.
I stare at your window.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，天一黑就好办。
lines.en: I wait for nightfall; it makes things easier.
Have you petted a dog? I look like one.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙鼓了一下。
lines.en: I lift my head, and my throat swells.
Don't crouch; if you crouch, I pounce.
I sniff your hand for a long time.
Can you tell what is wrong with me?
My eyes have one layer more than yours.
Try calling my name.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇尾巴，不太熟练。
lines.en: I wag my tail, clumsily.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我的喉咙就鼓起来。
lines.en: You back half a step and my throat swells.
Mucus hangs at my mouth.
Don't touch my back; it moves there.
I sit and slowly look up at you.
Nngh! This hide of mine has split.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收进腿间，撤了。
lines.en: I tuck my tail between my legs and withdraw.
The smell of blood excites me.
Don't hit my head; it comes loose.
I bare my teeth, all of them.
The pain rolls me over.
This hide is not very sturdy.
I kick back with my hind legs.

lines.zh: 那声叫不像狗，也不像人。
lines.en: That cry is neither dog nor man.
I lie low and breathe slowly.
Meat. I want meat.
What you hold smells like home.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一寸，没别的意思。
lines.en: I crept an inch forward. Nothing more.
Throw it. Don't hand it to me.
My throat is full of saliva.
I will sit nicely. See?
Eat this and I won't spit at you.
I smell bone.
Your fingers are very clean.

lines.zh: 我趴下，下巴贴着雪往前蹭。
lines.en: I lie down and push my chin through the snow.
Does a dog wag its tail like this?

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴唇，皮裂开了。
lines.en: I lick my lips, and the skin splits.
You are hesitating. I can tell.
Give it to me and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我肚子在叫，声音不像狗。
lines.en: My stomach growls, and it does not sound like a dog.
Keep your head down; I won't bite.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，皮翻起来一块。
lines.en: I collide with you and a flap of skin peels back.

lines.zh: 我的趾头在雪里，你踩实了。
lines.en: My toes are under the snow and you stepped down.

lines.zh: 我的重量比你看起来沉。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look.
I back off and shake my coat.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，雪飞起来。
lines.en: We collide, and snow sprays up.
I shove you sliding backward.
My shoulder hits you, hard.
Don't press on my back.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞进我肋骨间。
lines.en: Your knee sinks between my ribs.
I come at you again, lighter this time.
Stroke my ears; they are warm.
I rest my head on your lap.
I share half this hide with you.
I follow you without barking.

lines.zh: 你衣服上有柴火和油烟。
lines.en: Your clothes carry woodsmoke and grease.
I lean in, tail drumming the ground.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出很低的声音。
lines.en: A low sound rises in my throat.
Don't go far; I dislike the snow.

lines.zh: 我把找到的骨头留给你。
lines.en: I saved the bone I found for you.
We crouch by the fire together.
I can carry this in my teeth.
I pick it up and trot two steps.
Not meat, but useful.
I bury it in the snow.
Something is stuck to my paw.
I hold it in my mouth and won't give it up.
This one crunches nicely.
I sniff it, then pick it up again.
Was this yours? Not anymore.
I tuck it under my belly.
I raise my head and my throat swells.
At this range even a dog couldn't dodge.
All four of my legs go rigid.

lines.zh: 喉咙里那口东西已经上来了。
lines.en: The stuff in my throat has risen.
My mouth is filling up.

lines.zh: 你身上有味道，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell, and I don't like it.
All four legs sink and my tail goes stiff.
Out of everyone, I picked you.
I step off to the side.
You cannot dodge this one.

lines.zh: 我没跑，只是没让你掉出视线。
lines.en: I am not running; I just won't lose sight of you.

lines.zh: 你跑进屋里，我就在门口。
lines.en: You run inside; I wait at the door.
I look up, throat pulsing.

lines.zh: 别躲在墙后，我看得见影子。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the wall; I see your shadow.
Your prints are all over the snow.
I hold the sticky stuff in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你听见低沉的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear that low rumbling?
I keep my body very low.
The smell is getting closer.
I spit at point-blank; you cannot dodge.
My forepaw pins your leg.
My teeth sink in and I shake my head.
I lunge and spit at the same time.

lines.zh: 四只脚一齐蹬地，撞你腰侧。
lines.en: All four feet drive into your flank.

lines.zh: 抓到了，一道很深的爪痕。
lines.en: Got you — a deep claw mark.
You fall, and I press down.
I shake my head and tear.
What I spit out is scalding.
I step back and bite again.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了一团热的东西。
lines.en: Something warm has appeared on the snow.

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，四只脚。
lines.en: I step out from behind the tree on four legs.
My first breath hurts my lungs.
This hide is new and still shiny.

lines.zh: 雪块从这层皮上滑下去。
lines.en: Clumps of snow slide off this hide.

lines.zh: 远处有个村子，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is a village far off; I can smell it.
I try to stand, legs trembling.
Someone left footprints.
I lie down, copying a dog.
The wind is cold, and I don't mind.

lines.zh: 这身皮怕火，我滚进雪里。
lines.en: This hide fears fire; I roll in the snow.
I fell and snapped a leg.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉囊，我吐不出来。
lines.en: Water fills my throat sac and I cannot spit it out.

lines.zh: 炸得我飞出去，皮都卷了。
lines.en: The blast throws me and my hide curls.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我肋间，很深。
lines.en: An arrow sinks deep between my ribs.

lines.zh: 紫色的光照过来，我的皮缩了。
lines.en: Violet light hits and my hide shrinks.
Hunger twists even my bark.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，四条腿一起软了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all four legs give way.

lines.zh: 四条腿蹬不到底，一直在掉。
lines.en: Four legs find no bottom and I keep falling.
